query.esql:
FROM logs-gitguardian.audit_log-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS `Event Count` = COUNT(*) BY `Time Bucket` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), `User Email` = user.email
| STATS `Event Count` = SUM(`Event Count`), email_count = SUM(`Event Count`) BY `User Email`
| SORT email_count DESC
| LIMIT 5
| KEEP `User Email`

FROM logs-gitguardian.audit_log-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| STATS `Event Count` = COUNT(*) BY `Time Bucket` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), `User Email` = user.email
| STATS `Event Count` = SUM(`Event Count`), email_count = SUM(`Event Count`) BY `User Email`
| SORT email_count DESC
| LIMIT 5
| KEEP `User Email`
